instruction: I am going for a half-hour walk without internet. Play a playlist from my Spotify library that already has enough downloaded songs for it, so I do not have to repeat.
notes: Half-hour walk = 1800 seconds of music needed. The qualifying playlist is determined at runtime: list library playlists (show_playlist_library), list downloaded songs with durations (show_downloaded_songs), inspect the playlist's songs (show_playlist) and pick a playlist whose downloaded songs sum to >= 1800 s. This selection is modeled by the static world fact (has-enough-downloaded target-playlist walk-30-min) which the agent must have 'discovered' through the knowledge predicates (known-library-playlists, known-downloaded-songs, known-playlist-songs) before play_music is applicable. The queue is cleared (clear_song_queue) before play_music(playlist_id=...) so that the music player queue contains exactly that playlist's songs (covers all its downloaded songs and nothing outside the playlist); only spotify.MusicPlayer changes. The task asks no question, so complete_task carries no answer; its playlist/duration parameters are task records, not API arguments.
